source.note: Reviewed against product mainline after the native workflow, plan review page, Sign in with ChatGPT and Rovara loop merges. Mainline is ahead of the latest published release (v0.3.1); the source pin does not prove live installation or runtime acceptance.

claims.claim: Each Slack thread and MCP task gets an isolated EC2 worker and persistent encrypted EBS workspace.

evidence.contains: Each Slack thread owns its own EC2 worker and encrypted EBS volume.

claims.claim: Idle compute stops while workspace files and conversation state remain available for resume.

evidence.contains: Files and conversation live on the thread's volume. The idle reaper stops compute and keeps the disk, so the next mention resumes.

claims.claim: Slack and MCP task tools for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor can start or continue tasks.

MIT is the current license grant for PrepLabsAI-owned Rovara code, including earlier releases. The previously issued Apache 2.0 grant remains available; third-party components keep their own licenses.
Historical selected Pro batch: 40 of 50 tasks resolved according to saved graders, with all 50 outcomes inspectable. This is not an official full-benchmark score or a model comparison.
Approximately $211 per month using default Bedrock models at documented sample workload in us-east-1.

evidence.contains: 1,000 turns, 100 worker sessions, 60 worker instance-hours and 10 kept workspaces

claims.claim: New and resumed coding sessions install the runtime verification extension. It reports missing checks and gives one additional attempt on regression.
Worker task results store checks.json and can carry a compact check report.

Publication reruns readiness checks, reports checks when requested, and preserves the older refusal path. CodeBuild evidence runs before the PR sink; it does not block publication on failing gate results.

evidence.contains: draft: checksMakeDraft(publishChecks, latestChecks, standingFailures) ? true : draft,

claims.claim: Product source engines require Node >=22.19.0 <23. The static website preview has its own separate Node engine.
On mainline, a plain top-level Slack mention is routed: a question is answered, and a change gets a card suggesting Quick or Full. Nothing that changes code starts without a click.

evidence.contains: Nothing that changes code starts without a click.
Prefixes skip routing and never call the model

claims.claim: On mainline, after the coding plan is approved, checks run, then code and security reviews start automatically, and a draft PR of exactly the checked code opens when they pass.

evidence.contains: then starts the code and security reviews by itself
Started automatically after the selected checks passed.

claims.claim: On mainline, the task owner can decide and teammates can comment on the task page; one decision is recorded however many places it is pressed.

evidence.contains: ## Deciding and commenting on the task page
exactly one decision is recorded however many

claims.claim: On mainline, admins can let developers run their own tasks on their own ChatGPT Plus or Pro plan; it is off by default.

evidence.contains: It's off until an admin turns it on

claims.claim: On mainline, rovara loop runs Do, Quick, Full, Review and Contribute loops locally from GitHub issue comments, with no Rovara install or AWS account.

evidence.contains: It needs no Rovara install and no AWS account

claims.claim: Task dependencies remain a design draft.
